# Repository instructions

Follow AGENTS.md. Production uses the Vercel container API and direct TLS Neon Postgres; the static Pages application receives only its public API origin. SQLite is for local tests. Keep namespace, source revision and method identity on every boundary.

Source strings are data. Never add arbitrary URL fetching, secret-reading tools or external business actions. Require the reviewed briefing digest before an internal publication. Preserve generation fences and stable operation keys.

Reports derive from evidence. Baseline, actual inference and recorded replay stay separate. Missing results remain unavailable. Archive verification and CI tests do not establish new model execution, public deployment or scheduler success. Keep credentials out of commits and generated artifacts.
